note: P4276 (Pro 25:28) — a man without self-control is like a city broken into, without walls.

dims.v: self-mastery — its absence leaves a man defenceless
the self-control/restraint of spirit whose absence leaves a man as defenceless as a city broken open and left without walls — the ruin of ungoverned passions
(the breached city he is likened to)
the self-mastery whose lack exposes a man to every assault

matsar ruach (restraint of spirit / self-control) — 'a man without SELF-CONTROL is like a city broken into and left without walls'; without command of his own spirit a man has no defence — every passion and impulse storms in at will. Self-mastery is the wall of the soul (cf 16:32).
